reference_argv: SELECT d.entry_name,cm.method_idx,cm.access_flags,CASE WHEN ci.insns_off IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CAST(ci.insns_off AS TEXT) END AS insns_off,CASE WHEN ci.insns_size IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CAST(ci.insns_size AS TEXT) END AS insns_size FROM class_methods cm JOIN dex_files d ON d.file_id=cm.file_id LEFT JOIN code_items ci ON ci.file_id=cm.file_id AND ci.method_idx=cm.method_idx ORDER BY cm.file_id,cm.method_idx
scope: full raw insns off/size/SHA and no-body state, plus unchanged legacy selected raw resources; not full business/ART/SQL/performance qualification
